## Health and privacy review

- [ ] Fixtures contain synthetic data only
- [ ] No `.env`, service-role credential, private key, or patient information is committed
- [ ] Generated output is not presented as diagnosis, treatment, or physician approval
- [ ] External-service and deployment assumptions are documented
